title: 'The Blockchain Can't Be Hacked' - Myth or Fact?
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. The chain itself is very hard to rewrite, but most losses come from stolen keys, fake sites and weak apps. Sources: bitcoin.org and ethereum.org security guides. AI-generated voice. Have you ever double checked a link before connecting your wallet? Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: MYTH OR FACT
scenes.narration: The blockchain can't be hacked. Myth or fact?

scenes.head: THE FACT
scenes.hook: REWRITING THE CHAIN IS VERY HARD
scenes.narration: Changing old blocks on a big network like Bitcoin would take enormous computing power. That part is real.

scenes.head: THE MYTH
scenes.hook: YOU AND YOUR APPS CAN STILL BE HACKED
scenes.narration: Losses usually come from stolen keys, fake websites, phishing links and buggy apps built on top of the chain.

scenes.head: THE FIX
scenes.hook: PROTECT YOUR KEYS. CHECK EVERY LINK
scenes.narration: Never share your seed phrase, turn on two factor login, and type official addresses yourself.

scenes.narration: Follow for one crypto basic a day. Educational only. Not financial advice.
